thread:
maria: Heads up — large spike in SCIM deprovisions around 12:03 UTC. Okta SAML assertions show TTL=0 for a subset. KMS decrypts OK. Anyone else seeing assertion TTL mismatches?
ashley: Seeing it in the audit stream too. Pattern: user created via SCIM -> role assign attempt -> immediate deprov. RBAC grant event missing. Logs show "assertion_expired" but assertion timestamps look current.
raj: Can you paste a sample assertion (sanitized)? Could be clock skew between IdP and our verifier.
maria: Pasting shortened snippet: ```<saml:Assertion IssueInstant="2026-03-21T12:03:25Z" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-21T12:03:25Z">...``` NotOnOrAfter == IssueInstant (zero TTL).
tom: That looks like an IdP problem — their app config may be mapping session TTL incorrectly. I'll ping the customer contact.
maria: Note: KMS decrypt logs show context {tenant: redwood-prod} so encryption is fine. Also some asserts missing the affiliation attr we use for RBAC, so grant fails even if assertion valid.
ashley: SCIM worker shows retries with 403 after deprov. Trace: svc-scim -> auth-proxy -> assertion-verifier. Verifier logs: "assertion not valid: ttl window outside allowed 5s".
raj: Wait, our allowed skew should be 60s (we bumped it last year). Did a config roll change that?
maria: APP_ASSERTION_SKEW on scim-worker was 5 due to config release this morning. Looks like the new default got shipped. Rolling back? 
Tom: Also FYI the customer rotated IdP certs yesterday; some IdP adapters re-sign assertions and they may have a local policy that sets zero duration for short-lived sessions.
sre-bot: deploy 17691-scim-config rolled at 12:00 UTC by ci-bot :rocket: -> /deploys/17691
ashley: I'm going to roll scim-worker back to 60s and watch metrics.
maria: rolling back now.
maria: rollback complete — deprov spike dropping back toward baseline (:thumbsup:).
raj: Follow-up action: add assertion TTL sanity check and alert when NotOnOrAfter == IssueInstant or delta < 1s.
tom: I'll open an Okta support ticket and attach the sample assertion + audit events.
audit-bot: Audit event created: "privilege_assignment_failed" x7 users; reason=missing_affiliation_attr; thread=1769012345
maria: Filing vuln-triage: severity=low (IdP misconfig + our bad config). Mitigation applied (rollback). Notes: harden assertion parsing, increase skew default, add integration test.
ashley: I'll own the follow-ups — add acceptance test to ensure NotOnOrAfter > IssueInstant + 1s and config guardrails.
tom: Thanks all. Closing here once Okta confirms their app update.
